plan.notes: Source: official NYU Bulletin Sample Plan of Study for Computer Science (BS), NYSED 08772 / HEGIS 0701.00 / CIP 11.0101, live PDF at https://bulletins.nyu.edu/undergraduate/engineering/programs/computer-science-bs/computer-science-bs.pdf (2026-2027 NYU Bulletins; PDF created 2026-06-03; bulletin accurate as of June 2025). Transcribed term-by-term from the Sample Plan of Study table (8 semesters, 128 credits total); course codes/titles/credits copied verbatim from the official PDF. This is the Tandon School of Engineering program (Brooklyn, NY), NOT the College of Arts and Science (CAS) — CAS has its own separate computer science major with different requirements. Per the official bulletin: a grade of C- or better is required in CS-UY 1114, CS-UY 1134, and CS-UY 2124; students placed into MA-UY 914 Precalculus for Engineers must defer MA-UY 1024; students who took CS-UY 1113 + CS-UY 1121 may count 4 credits toward the major in lieu of CS-UY 1114. Humanities and Social Sciences: one of the four HSS slots must be an Ethics course and one must be an Advanced Seminar course (see NYU Tandon General Education Requirements). MA-UY 914 does not count toward the Math requirement. MA-UY 2034 Linear Algebra and Differential Equations (or another linear algebra course) is recommended but not required. Per-course prerequisite chains are not stated in the bulletin sample plan, so prereq lists are left empty rather than invented.
